from __future__ import annotations
import re
from shopkit.core.order_engine import formatOrderRef, parseOrderRef

_REF_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?<![\w-])(?:[A-Za-z]{2,3}[ -]+\d{4}[ -]+\d+|ORD_[0-9A-Za-z]+)(?![\w-])",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

def order_refs(text: str) -> list[str]:
    if not text:
        return []
    out: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for m in _REF_RE.finditer(text):
        candidate = m.group(0)
        parsed = parseOrderRef(candidate)
        if parsed is None:
            continue
        ref = formatOrderRef(*parsed)
        if ref not in seen:
            seen.add(ref)
            out.append(ref)
    return out

from __future__ import annotations

import re

from shopkit.core.order_engine import CONFIG, formatOrderRef, parseOrderRef

# Candidate reference-like spans in free text.  The old form is checked against
# parseOrderRef below; the new form is recognised case-insensitively.
_CANDIDATE_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?<![\w-])(?:[A-Za-z]+[\s-]+\d{4}[\s-]+\d+|ORD_[0-9A-Za-z]+)(?![\w-])",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_WS_RE = re.compile(r"\s+")

def order_refs(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return canonical order references found in *text*, in first-seen order."""
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text:
        return []
    prefix = str(CONFIG.get("refPrefix", "SO")).upper()
    old_kinds = {prefix, prefix + "B"}
    out: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for match in _CANDIDATE_RE.finditer(text):
        candidate = _WS_RE.sub(" ", match.group(0))
        parsed = parseOrderRef(candidate)
        if parsed is None:
            continue
        kind, year, seq = parsed
        if kind != "ord" and kind not in old_kinds:
            continue
        ref = formatOrderRef(kind, year, seq)
        if ref not in seen:
            seen.add(ref)
            out.append(ref)
    return out

import re

from shopkit.core.order_engine import CONFIG, formatOrderRef, parseOrderRef

# Candidate reference-like spans in free text.  The old form is checked against

_CANDIDATE_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?<![\w-])(?:[A-Za-z]+[\s-]+\d{4}[\s-]+\d+|ORD_[0-9A-Za-z]+)(?![\w-])",
    re.IGNORECASE,

_WS_RE = re.compile(r"\s+")

def order_refs(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return canonical order references found in *text*, in first-seen order."""
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text:
        return []
    prefix = str(CONFIG.get("refPrefix", "SO")).upper()
    old_kinds = {prefix, prefix + "B"}
    out: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for match in _CANDIDATE_RE.finditer(text):
        candidate = _WS_RE.sub(" ", match.group(0))
        parsed = parseOrderRef(candidate)
        if parsed is None:
            continue
        kind, year, seq = parsed
        if kind != "ord" and kind not in old_kinds:
            continue
        ref = formatOrderRef(kind, year, seq)
        if ref not in seen:
            seen.add(ref)
            out.append(ref)
    return out
